questions.prompt: Which of the following components is typically NOT a part of Built-In Self-Test (BIST) infrastructure?
The patterns obtained using Linear Feedback Shift Register (LFSR) are:
What is aliasing in signature analysis from the perspective of Built-In Self-Test (BIST)
options: Matching of signature of “good” circuit and “faulty” circuit
Matching of signature of the designer and the signature of the engineer who is fabricating
Overlapping of frequency components in automatic test equipment
Distortion in the outline of the image of the chip taken during testing
questions.accepted: Matching of signature of “good” circuit and “faulty” circuit

questions.prompt: What is the primary purpose of ion implantation in integrated circuit fabrication?
options: Growing a thick layer of oxide

questions.prompt: A metal interconnect line in an integrated circuit has a sheet resistance of 0.06 Ohms per square. The length of the interconnect is 10 microns and the width is 0.01 microns. What is the resistance of the interconnect?
The lateral capacitance between two adjacent interconnects running parallelly in the same layer will increase under which of the following conditions?
options: The dielectric constant of the insulator between them is decreased.
The sidewall area of the interconnects is increased.
The distance between the interconnects is increased.
The overlapping length between them is decreased.
questions.accepted: The sidewall area of the interconnects is increased.

questions.prompt: Which of the following phenomenon is typically NOT a manifestation of signal integrity issues in an integrated circuit?
options: Increase in delay from the base delay.
Decrease in delay from the base delay.
Introduction of a defect in a manufactured chip.
Glitches in a signal within an integrated circuit.
questions.accepted: Introduction of a defect in a manufactured chip.
